summary: Frontend-only validation of editable 'Bancos o Entes' column on Item 1 'Suscripción PDV/Banco' (data-testid=setup-bancos-inherit-0) in the Quote Wizard Setup section. All 7 behavioral assertions PASS: editable input, default inherits header, header propagates while no manual edit, manual edit accepted with amber/unlock indicator, total recalculates, header changes do NOT overwrite manual override, and re-typing header value re-inherits (blue, no amber). The recurring twin item ('Derecho de uso de plataforma MServer por PDV') correctly remains read-only N/A as per scope.

issues: React hydration warnings about <span> children of <tbody>/<tr> from editable-veneer instrumentation. NOT introduced by this iteration.

test_steps_executed: Opened Nueva Implementación → Clientes Pymes → wizard dialog rendered.
Selected Tipo='VPOS', Modelo='Modelo Convencional', Cliente=first (Beijing La Gringa), Integrador=first option — triggered render of Setup table with 4 items.
T1 Initial state: setup-bancos-inherit-0 is INPUT (readOnly=false, disabled=false), value=1 matching header 'cantidad-bancos-input', styling blue (no amber). PASS.
T2 Set header=3 via React native setter → item 1 inherits to 3, Total recomputes to $60.00 (cajas=1 × tarifa=20 × bancos=3). PASS.
T3 Manually set inherit-0=5 → value=5, class flips to amber/border-amber-400/bg-amber-50, Unlock icon (svg.text-amber-500) visible, Total recalculates to $100.00 (1×20×5). PASS.
T4 Changed header to 2 → item 1 stays at 5 (manual override preserved), still amber, Total still $100.00 — NO overwrite. PASS.
T5 Typed 2 (= current header) on inherit-0 → bancosManual cleared: class returns to blue/bg-blue-50, Unlock icon disappears, Total drops to $40.00 (1×20×2). PASS.
T6 Changed header to 4 after re-inherit → item 1 follows to 4 (blue), Total $80.00. PASS.

Visual confirmation in screenshot: Item 2 'Configuración dispositivo (Pinpad o POS)' and Item 3 'Configuración PDV en MServer' show N/A (Base/N/A badges) and Item 4 'Configuración Medio de Pago / Banco en MServer' uses the Auto path — only Item 1 was changed to inheritBancos editable as per scope. The recurring 'Derecho de uso de plataforma MServer por PDV' still shows N/A as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: QuoteWizardDialog.jsx lines 1392-1419: onChange logic is correct — empty string → fall back to headerVal and isManual=false (so blanking clears the override). Use of `parseInt(raw) || 1` ensures min 1 and matches isManual computation. totalOverride is cleared on every change which is the right behavior to force recompute via tarifa*cajas*bancos.
Quotes.jsx line 630: useEffect propagation correctly guards `!item.bancosManual` so manual overrides are NOT overwritten by header changes.
QuoteWizardDialog.jsx is 2344 lines — strong candidate for modularization (Setup table, Recurring tables, hardware section, etc.). Pre-existing tech debt, not blocking.
Pre-existing console hydration warnings about <span> inside <tbody>/<tr> from veneer instrumentation persist; not user-impacting.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter51 validated the 'Bancos o Entes' editable override on Item 1 'Suscripción PDV/Banco' (setup-bancos-inherit-0) in the Quote Wizard Setup. Tip for next testers: to set values on controlled React inputs (Radix UI), prefer using the native setter via JS `Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLInputElement.prototype,'value').set` followed by dispatching an 'input' event with bubbles=true — Playwright's fill('')+type can produce unexpected concatenations when the React onChange re-renders to a different default (as happened initially during this iteration). To reach the Setup table the wizard requires Tipo + Modelo de Precios + Cliente + Integrador all selected; only then the Setup section renders. The Implementaciones menu has two entries: Clientes Pymes (used here) and Clientes Corporativos.
